explication: rhwp is a Rust document engine for viewing and editing HWP, HWPX, and supported HML files, exposed through WebAssembly, CLI, desktop, and platform integrations. The main workflow parses a document into a shared model, composes and paginates it, then renders or saves it; Studio adds interactive editing and document commands. The README documents broader format and output capabilities than the sampled source excerpts. Some indexed core paths are absent from the supplied tree, so those paths follow the explicit SOURCE INDEX; unsampled subsystem links are limited to documented relationships.
